before.title: What the frozen page says about words that do not change
before.body: The frozen page says these have irregular genders, and are indeclinable (that is, they don't change according to case or number). ра́дио — radio. такси́ — taxi.

after.title: Nouns that keep their form
after.body: An indeclinable noun keeps the same form for case or number. In these examples, ра́дио and такси́ are indeclinable. Recognize the behavior of the shown noun.

before.title: Four admitted rows with the flag set
before.body: The admitted rows below have the flag set. That flag is the record used here. метро́ — metro. кино́ — cinema. пальто́ — coat. ко́фе — coffee.

after.title: Four more unchanged nouns
after.body: The nouns метро́, кино́, пальто́ and ко́фе are also indeclinable. Their forms stay unchanged for case or number. Learn the noun with this behavior; do not infer that every noun with a similar ending behaves the same way.

before.title: Two more admitted rows with the flag set
before.body: The admitted rows below have the flag set. кафе́ — café. меню́ — menu.

after.title: Recognize the behavior
after.body: кафе́ and меню́ are two more indeclinable nouns. An unchanged word form does not mean that a sentence has no case relationships. These checks classify the shown noun; they do not test production of a sentence or a complete paradigm.

before.title: Remediation
before.body: Return to the explanation. Compare the shown form with the admitted record. Do not invent a form that is absent from the record.

after.title: Review noun behavior
after.body:
An indeclinable noun keeps the same form for case or number. In these examples, ра́дио and такси́ are indeclinable. Recognize the behavior of the shown noun.

The nouns метро́, кино́, пальто́ and ко́фе are also indeclinable. Their forms stay unchanged for case or number. Learn the noun with this behavior; do not infer that every noun with a similar ending behaves the same way.

кафе́ and меню́ are two more indeclinable nouns. An unchanged word form does not mean that a sentence has no case relationships. These checks classify the shown noun; they do not test production of a sentence or a complete paradigm.

Contrast кни́га and окно́: these nouns are declinable, so they can change for case. Their nominative and genitive forms differ. Choose the behavior of the shown noun: unchanged for case or number, or able to change for case. No new form needs to be invented.

before.title: Guided practice
before.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

after.title: Guided noun classification
after.body: Choose how the shown noun behaves. Read the explanation after choosing.

before.title: Independent checks
before.body: These checks use only admitted records. A miss returns to the explanation.

after.title: Independent noun classification
after.body: Classify the shown noun by its case behavior. A miss returns to all four explanations and the retained examples.
